inventions: The Hall of Names owns two hundred chairs and replies run to about twice that, so Kade hauls Meridian dining chairs on a facilities cart. 'Four hundred people' watched him stand.
Anton gives Kade a 9:00 deadline to choose the House object. Julian's specimen bag carries the note 'From Systems Lab, on loan. It stands for the work.'
Kade's tape label on Eli's bench mat reads 'ROTOR OUT ON LOAN. RETURNING. K.' It is later paired with the wafer.

The Hall's biography office wrote the draft from the academy record, and the House corrects it on the corkboard with a pen on a string, including Sera's and Priya's margin notes. In the source Julian wrote it.
An unnamed steward in gray gloves receives the House object and runs the memorial with no fixed speaking order. The steward's line 'That's what the cloth is for' explains the unmounted name.

Anton states the custom of the House roll: a strip goes on a bed when someone is missing, dead or arrested, and 'arrested is on the list'. This extends the chapter 27 roll custom and may count as a new House rule.
Hale opens the Hall door a hand's width as Kade heads for it. Kade reflects on the open door with a callback to the shuttle gate of chapters 25 and 27.
Speech material: the noodle-box label, the model's twenty-three columns (chapter 8), 'He asked if I'd eaten', 'He'd file a complaint about the plaque', and 'Then give it to Sera.'
Priya's testimony: 'Two of them were right. I never told him which.' The source has 'He was wrong. Mostly.'
Kim's line: 'I've since used that on two committees. I'd like to correct the attribution.'
Ortiz collects the housing from the technician's lap mid-ceremony and says 'best question anyone's asked me in ten years, and I gave him half an answer.'

Kade drafts a message to his mother ('Spoke. Tried to leave first, then didn't. Calling tonight.') and she is on shift until six. The NULL-7 alert arrives disguised as a housing filter notice that repeats three times.

New lines from Eli: 'THAT IS ANNOYINGLY RIGOROUS. I BLAME MARA.'; the MERCER GETS CLEVER HERE proof; 'DO NOT LET ANYONE CLOSE THE TICKET FROM MARCH. THIS CHANNEL IS LOAD-BEARING.'; 'POSSIBLY THIS.'; 'I AM TOLD YOU USED THE PRESENT TENSE. THANK YOU FOR THAT.'
A Sol boy looks to Kade on the Hall steps, and a Kepler girl asks Taren about his strip. Both are unnamed and both Houses already exist.
The closing image is Kade reading into the ENDS: ON RETURN, OR DAY SEVEN card all the way down the stairs.

Finding f02 (Professor Kim) is only partly repaired. The draft keeps Professor Kim distinct from the chapter 27 orange-tool-case professor: both are seated separately in the Hall, and in the courtyard the tool-case professor remains 'she'. The draft does not restore Kim's male pronouns from the source. It avoids every pronoun for Kim and drops the given name 'Dae'. I chose this neutral workaround because the packet records no human canon ruling and source chapter 33 conflicts with source chapter 28. If the ruling goes to the chapter 28 source, male pronouns need adding, which is a small edit.

Possible continuity conflict I introduced: line 71 says Taren was 'not cleared to set foot in Meridian'. In the source he comes to the Meridian common-room door under escort, and rewritten chapter 27 line 177 has Taren on a landing, apparently inside Meridian. I did not verify that location. The line is an invented restriction that supports the relocation to the Hall steps. It may need softening, for example to say he chose not to come to the House.

Action reassignments from the source. Kade carries the rotor to the Hall, where the source has Priya carry it and states 'Kade carried nothing'. Julian deletes the standing sentence and types NOT RELEVANT, which Priya did in the source; here Priya prompts it. Anton delivers the 'marks who's gone' argument that was Priya's in the source. Sera takes a pre-cut spare strip from her pocket instead of cutting a new length. Julian is no longer the person who explains the loose name.

The speech's tense changes from the source's 'Eli was worth it' to 'Eli's worth it', with Kade noticing the tense. Eli's reply replaces the source's 'THAT'S THE SPIRIT'. I judge this consistent with the ledger's 'publicly naming Eli worth the cost', but it alters a signature line.
